description: Read the account's own working hours: the weekly windows it takes work in, and how many days ahead a booking can be made. Read it before offering a customer a time, so what you offer is a time the account actually works. An account with nothing configured is a normal answer rather than a failure - it means these hours have never been set up in Housecall Pro, and one account having them says nothing about another.
name: hcp_get_schedule_availability
